description: The reference history with a 120-day rising tail; CMP 359.91 sits high on the Monthly curve.
explanation: R1: the curve position uses CMP only. HOC permits a buy only in extreme circumstances with sector support (RB 1600-1601; sector not evaluated), so G3 is MANUAL. R5 / RB 1901: HOC + Up for a demand long is REJECT (buying expensive), so G4 FAILs and a FAIL outranks everything (spec 8), even though the zone itself is still fresh and 7/7.
title: Price HOC on the curve with a Strong Up trend: REJECTED
